intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Engineered for your everyday
features.text: Strong, supportive, and thoughtfully built — our engineered wood frame gives you peace of mind that your bed is here to stay, night after night.

features.title: Headboard that balances form and function
features.text: Broad and rectangular, our headboard adds structure to your space while offering the perfect support for reading, lounging or morning cups of tea.

features.title: Effortless organisation beneath the surface
features.text: The box-style underbed compartments offer easy access to the things that matter. It’s smart storage that helps you make the most of your space, effortlessly. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Light, natural, and endlessly versatile
features.text: The Sonoma oak surface brings a soft, neutral finish that brightens your room and blends beautifully with your décor — whether classic or contemporary.

features.title: Protected beauty that lasts
features.text: A PU coating helps keep your bed looking its best, resisting everyday nicks and wear while maintaining its elegant finish.

name: Upmods Eudora Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
